commission.title: Platform Commission
commission.description: Set the single authoritative platform commission for future session allocations. The practitioner share is always the exact remainder to 100.00%.
commission.derivedHint: Derived by the Backend as 100.00% minus platform commission.
commission.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why this financial split is changing...
commission.mismatch: The existing local and cross-border defaults are different. Choose one platform commission and save to explicitly unify both defaults.
commission.saved: Commission saved for future allocations. Existing payment and ledger snapshots were not changed.
commission.error: The commission could not be saved. Reload the latest value and try again.
commission.note: This change is audited and applies prospectively. Accountant approval and immutable payment snapshots remain authoritative for historical earnings.
